name: Grendel's Father
source:
Co-founder of The Council Of The Unseen, along with his wife, with a simple mission : take over the world.

Originally hailing from the newspaper world, he was the victim of numerous witchhunts over his investigative journalism, which made him cynical and bitter.

With agents in every corner of the world, The Council has infiltrated almost all governmental and financial institutions, quietly changing things behind the scenes and mostly without anyone knowing.

The Council don't have it all their own way.  Rival organisations are constantly trying to undermine missions, whilst The Phoenix Custodians (and allies) try to stop them as well.
And that doesn't take into account internal rivalries and jealousies, all of which undermine The Council's ability to function properly.

Frederick deals with internal dissent the only way he knows : Sends the miscreants to the "Happy Glowstick Funtime Re-education Camp".  Kept secret from almost everyone, including his wife, it's the subject of much speculation and rumours.

Frederick believes holidays should be earned, and generally views all Grendels efforts as incompetent, so she generally has to clean the top ten floors of their base come Christmas time.  He also has no problem throwing Grendel in one of the underground prisons, if he feels her loyalty wavers at any point.

Deems the protagonist saving Grendel from the exploding tower (WTC 2/2) as a sign of weakness on Grendel's behalf, and despite returning Grendel safely after defeating the "Company of Ibauric", still mercilessly punishes the protagonist, and starts planning for his/her demise.
